title: [03.16] Pie - Đánh giá hỗ trợ CNTT & giờ mở cửa thư viện trường (10.01)
prompt: The charts below show the results of a survey conducted by a university library to find out the opinions of full time and part time students about its services. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide:
### 📌 HƯỚNG DẪN TỪNG BƯỚC VIẾT TASK 1 (TRẠM IELTS)

---
### PHẦN 1: HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT INTRODUCTION (1 câu)

#### Bước 1: Phân tích đề bài (Xác định 5 yếu tố)
* **1. What (Đối tượng):** Mức độ hài lòng của sinh viên đối với hai dịch vụ thư viện: Hỗ trợ công nghệ thông tin (IT support) và Giờ mở cửa hiện tại (currently opening hours).
* **2. Who (Của ai):** Sinh viên toàn thời gian (Full-time students) và Sinh viên bán thời gian (Part-time students).
* **3. Levels (Các mức đánh giá):** Rất hài lòng (Very happy), Khá hài lòng (Quite happy), và Hoàn toàn không hài lòng (Not at all).
* **4. When (Thời gian):** Khảo sát tại một thời điểm (biểu đồ tĩnh, dùng thì hiện tại đơn hoặc quá khứ đơn).
* **5. Unit (Đơn vị đo):** Phần trăm (%).

#### Bước 2: Tìm từ đồng nghĩa (Paraphrasing)
* *show the results of a survey* => *illustrate survey findings*
* *opinions of full time and part time students* => *the satisfaction levels of full-time and part-time undergraduates*
* *about its services (IT and opening hours)* => *regarding IT support and current opening hours at a university library*

#### Bước 3: Công thức và Câu viết hoàn chỉnh
* **Công thức:** `The pie charts illustrate + [the satisfaction levels of full-time and part-time students] + regarding IT support and opening hours + at a university library.`
* **Câu viết hoàn chỉnh (Band 7.0):**
> *The pie charts illustrate the satisfaction levels of full-time and part-time students regarding IT support and opening hours at a university library.*

---
### PHẦN 2: HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT OVERVIEW (2 câu)

#### Bước 1: Xác định 2 đặc điểm nổi bật nhất
* **Đặc điểm 1 (Giờ mở cửa được đánh giá rất cao):** Cả sinh viên full-time lẫn part-time đều cực kỳ hài lòng với giờ mở cửa thư viện (đều trên 70% chọn 'Very happy').
* **Đặc điểm 2 (Sự bất đồng về hỗ trợ CNTT):** Dịch vụ IT support có sự phân hóa trái ngược rõ rệt: sinh viên full-time nhìn chung rất hài lòng (hơn một nửa chọn 'Very happy'), trong khi sinh viên part-time phần lớn lại bất mãn (45% chọn 'Not at all').

#### Bước 2: Ráp câu hoàn chỉnh (Band 7.0)
* **Câu 1 (Đặc điểm giờ mở cửa):** *Overall, both full-time and part-time students were overwhelmingly satisfied with the library's current opening hours.*
* **Câu 2 (Đặc điểm hỗ trợ CNTT):** *In contrast, while full-time students held a largely positive view of the IT support service, part-time learners expressed considerable dissatisfaction.*

---
### PHẦN 3: CHIẾN THUẬT CHIA THÂN BÀI (PARAGRAPH DIVISION)

Ta chia thân bài tương ứng theo **từng dịch vụ được khảo sát**:
* **Body 1 (Dịch vụ hỗ trợ công nghệ thông tin - IT Support):**
  * Full-time: 54% Very happy, 31% Quite happy, chỉ 15% Not at all.
  * Part-time: 45% Not at all (cao nhất), 35% Quite happy, chỉ 20% Very happy.
* **Body 2 (Thời gian mở cửa thư viện - Opening Hours):**
  * Full-time: 87% Very happy, 12% Quite happy, chỉ 1% Not at all.
  * Part-time: 72% Very happy, 23% Quite happy, chỉ 5% Not at all.

---
### PHẦN 4: KỸ THUẬT CHỌN ĐIỂM DỮ LIỆU ĐẮT GIÁ

* **IT Support - Full-time:** Đa số hài lòng (tổng cộng 85% chọn 'Very happy' hoặc 'Quite happy'), tỉ lệ không hài lòng chỉ 15%.
* **IT Support - Part-time:** Tỉ lệ bất mãn 'Not at all' chiếm tới 45% (cao gấp 3 lần so với sinh viên full-time).
* **Opening Hours - Full-time:** Đạt tỉ lệ hài lòng áp đảo với 87% chọn 'Very happy', tỉ lệ 'Not at all' chỉ là 1% (gần như bằng 0).
* **Opening Hours - Part-time:** Tỉ lệ 'Very happy' cũng chiếm đa số lớn với 72%.

---
### PHẦN 5: HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT CHI TIẾT TỪNG BODY (BAND 7.0)

#### BODY 1: ĐÁNH GIÁ VỀ HỖ TRỢ CÔNG NGHỆ THÔNG TIN (3 câu)
* **Câu 1 (Sinh viên Full-time hài lòng):** *Regarding IT support, more than half of full-time students (54%) reported being very happy with the service, while an additional 31% were quite happy.*
* **Câu 2 (Full-time không hài lòng rất ít):** *Only 15% of full-time respondents expressed complete dissatisfaction with this service.*
* **Câu 3 (Sinh viên Part-time thất vọng):** *In sharp contrast, the largest group of part-time students (45%) were not at all satisfied with IT support, with only 20% giving a very happy rating and 35% feeling quite happy.*

#### BODY 2: ĐÁNH GIÁ VỀ GIỜ MỞ CỬA THƯ VIỆN (3 câu)
* **Câu 1 (Full-time đánh giá giờ mở cửa xuất sắc):** *In terms of library opening hours, approval ratings were considerably higher across both student groups, with 87% of full-time learners being very happy.*
* **Câu 2 (Số ít còn lại của Full-time):** *The remaining full-time students were either quite happy (12%) or completely dissatisfied (a negligible 1%).*
* **Câu 3 (Sinh viên Part-time cũng đánh giá cao):** *Similarly, a clear majority of part-time students (72%) stated they were very happy with the operational hours, followed by 23% who were quite happy and only 5% who expressed discontent.*

---
### PHẦN 6: TỔNG HỢP CÔNG THỨC FULL BÀI (CHEATSHEET)

1. **Intro:** `The pie charts illustrate [satisfaction levels of full-time and part-time students] regarding [IT support and opening hours] at a university library.`
2. **Overview:** `Overall, both groups strongly favored current opening hours. However, full-time students liked IT support, whereas part-time students were largely dissatisfied.`
3. **Body 1 (IT Support):** `Full-time students were [54%] very happy and [31%] quite happy (only [15%] unhappy). Part-time students were [45%] not satisfied at all (only [20%] very happy).`
4. **Body 2 (Opening hours):** `[87%] of full-time students and [72%] of part-time students were very happy. Dissatisfaction was minimal at [1%] and [5%] respectively.`

---
### PHẦN 7: BÀI BÁO CÁO MẪU HOÀN CHỈNH (BAND 7.0 REPORT)

The pie charts illustrate the satisfaction levels of full-time and part-time students regarding IT support and opening hours at a university library.

Overall, both full-time and part-time students were overwhelmingly satisfied with the library's current opening hours. In contrast, while full-time students held a largely positive view of the IT support service, part-time learners expressed considerable dissatisfaction.

Regarding IT support, more than half of full-time students (54%) reported being very happy with the service, while an additional 31% were quite happy. Only 15% of full-time respondents expressed complete dissatisfaction with this service. In sharp contrast, the largest group of part-time students (45%) were not at all satisfied with IT support, with only 20% giving a very happy rating and 35% feeling quite happy.

In terms of library opening hours, approval ratings were considerably higher across both student groups, with 87% of full-time learners being very happy. The remaining full-time students were either quite happy (12%) or completely dissatisfied (a negligible 1%). Similarly, a clear majority of part-time students (72%) stated they were very happy with the operational hours, followed by 23% who were quite happy and only 5% who expressed discontent.
